HERE’S HOW I DID IT ⬇️ When I created my first digital product, I honestly thought… “Maybe this little eBook could help me pay a few bills.” I wasn’t trying to build some massive online business. I just wanted a little breathing room. I wanted to make money without adding more clients, working longer days, or giving up the little free time I had left. But that one digital product ended up DOUBLING the income I was making behind the chair. And that changed what I believed was possible for me. I realized my income didn’t have to stop every time I stopped working. I could take something I already knew, turn it into a simple digital product, and sell it more than once—even while I was sleeping, at the salon, or living my life. And no, I wasn’t tech-savvy. I didn’t know what kind of product to create. I didn’t even understand why anyone would pay for a PDF. I had to learn everything from the beginning. That’s exactly why I created Leveraging Your First Digital Product a beginner-friendly, step-by-step course that walks you through choosing your idea, creating your product, and learning how to sell it online. No guessing. No complicated tech. No needing to become an influencer. Just the process I wish someone had shown me when I started. If you want to learn, check out the link at the top of my profile 🥰 My results are personal to me and aren’t a guarantee of what anyone else will earn.

If I had to make my first $5K this month with digital products, I would NOT start by creating everything from scratch. Here’s the exact PLR path I’d follow: 1️⃣ Choose ONE audience. 2️⃣ Find ONE urgent problem they’re already searching for help with. 3️⃣ Purchase a quality PLR product that solves that problem. 4️⃣ Rebrand it with a new title, cover, examples, and my own voice. 5️⃣ Add a bonus that makes the offer feel like a no-brainer. 6️⃣ Price it at $57. At $57, I would need 88 sales to make $5,016. That breaks down to about 3 sales per day. Now, creating the product is only step one. You still need a strategy to get those three daily sales.
